group.title: Group
group.description: The rate-limit group this entry's limits apply to.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: The workspace's limiter values for this group. By default only the limiter types with a workspace-level override are listed. With `include_inherited` set to `true`, the limiter types the workspace inherits from the organization are listed too, each marked by `source`.

models.title: Models
models.description: Model names this entry's limits apply to, including aliases. `null` when `group.type` is not `"model_group"`. The list covers the models this workspace has access to, so it can differ between workspaces.

rate_limit_id.title: Rate Limit Id
rate_limit_id.description: The `id` of the organization's RateLimit entry this entry applies to.

type.title: Type
type.description: Object type. Always `workspace_rate_limit` for workspace rate-limit entries.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: ID of the Workspace this entry applies to.
